reviews.review_msg: I had the pleasure of taking her class last semester. She is amazing at teaching, she is very good at introducing and explaining new concepts. Her slides are easy to read and study for. She is organized and communicates quickly. She is sweet and inspiring to be around. Merci beaucoup pour tout.

Amazing prof, course material covers a lot of different aspects of risk to appeal to everyone. The content was easily understood with readings provided if you didn't understand. Also very helpful during office hours.

She's very organized with learning objectives and doesn't test on onything not seen in class. Lectures seem heavy but are really condensed. Weekly quizzes to study for. She's very nice and wants to help. Class attendance is necessary for notes and assignments. In addition she's also very attractive.

She knows her stuff, and is generally very helpful. But you must follow her outline to the letter to get full points. Also expects you to put an honest effort into projects and papers rather than just getting answers right! (which I think is more important anyway.)
